# Lavendar Lewis & Stephen Irving

- [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) — presumed Romantically involved with — [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) — formerly engaged when young · since v2  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), +1 more</sub>
- [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) — Spouse of — [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) — married in honeysuckle arbor · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) on a wintry evening, and over tea and candy, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) recounts her long-ago romance and quarrel with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). A month later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) introduces Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and the two immediately form a fond friendship during their visit.
>
> — v2 · XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P17](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0017), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026)_

> After school finishes, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and meets his returning father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), who asks her to pass a message to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers the note to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and helps her prepare for Stephen's arrival that evening.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P42](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0042), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) help Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's visit to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). When [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) arrives, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) welcomes him and ushers him inside to meet Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) watch from the window as [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) walk in the garden together, confirming that the two have reconciled.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P64](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0064), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) help prepare for Miss Lavendar's wedding at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) before the intimate ceremony takes place in the garden as the sun breaks through the clouds. After seeing the newly married couple off at the station, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) return to tidy up the house, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later shares a quiet, subtly meaningful moment with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) before they leave.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House
